title: Automate model onboarding pipeline: build/sign/promote & publish perf profiles
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a repeatable CI/CD pipeline to onboard new model artifacts, produce and publish a verified performance profile, sign artifacts and provenance, and support promotion through staging->canary->production. Goals: reduce manual steps, guarantee signed artifacts and reproducible provenance, make version pinning and promotion auditable, and enable automated profile publishing to the models catalog used by hosting and Dedicated fleets.
steps: 1) Trigger pipeline from Git tag or GitHub PR to model-onboard repo
2) Fetch source model artifacts from vendor or model-repo-staging (checksum verification)
3) Build model runtime package (quantizations/compile) in isolated builder (GKE-runner), run unit smoke tests
4) Run deterministic benchmark harness (nightly/PR-level) to generate perf profile JSON
5) Sign built artifacts and provenance using cosign and store signatures in Artifact Registry
6) Upload artifacts and perf profile to models-catalog bucket with versioned prefix and manifest entry
7) Create promotion proposal in Console API for canary rollout (includes signature + profile link)
8) On approved promotion, update pinning manifests for hosted and dedicated deployment groups and notify infra teams
decisions: Use GitHub Actions for orchestration of model-onboard CI because it integrates with existing infra repos and OIDC to GCP; evaluate migrating heavy builds to Cloud Build if warm GPU pools required
Artifact signing will use cosign (sigstore) and produce SLSA-style provenance JSON attached to each artifact; this satisfies upcoming audit requirements
Perf profiles will be produced in a stable JSON schema (perf_v2) and include latency percentiles, token throughput, memory/KV footprint metrics and benchmark harness version tags
Models will be published to GCS + registered in the models-catalog service; catalog entries reference signed artifact uri, perf profile uri, and recommended runtime config
Promotion flow: manual approval required for production; automated canary promotions allowed for small models with no customer-sensitive data

acceptance_criteria: Pipeline executes end-to-end from PR tag to published catalog entry without manual intervention
All published artifacts have valid cosign signatures and SLSA provenance linked in the catalog
Perf profile (perf_v2) is attached to each catalog entry and passes schema validation
Promotion flow can create a canary rollout and update runtime pin manifests for hosted and Dedicated groups
Documentation exists for key rotation, signing keys, and how to reproduce the perf benchmark locally
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): Run pipeline on a handful of internal open-source models and validate signatures and catalog entries (2 weeks)
Phase 2 (canary): Enable automatic canary promotion for non-sensitive models and measure Console + runtime ingestion for verification (1 week)
Phase 3 (prod): Require manual approval for production promotion, enable for all public models, and run a security audit post-rollout
